comments.body:
Topics that we *could* discuss but not necessary are:

- Adding off-protocol-value to the bid: pros/cons (@fradamt was right that it has some good pros)
- Adding a censoring flag to the engine api return on new_payload (poor man's FOCIL)

in the [spec](https://ethereum.github.io/consensus-specs/specs/gloas/beacon-chain/#epoch-processing), `process_builder_pending_payments` runs at the end of `process_epoch`.  in `process_builder_pending_payments`, we call `get_builder_payment_quorum_threshold`, which calls `get_total_active_balance` as part of the quorum calculation.

However, `process_builder_pending_payments` is processing builder pending payments from the previous epoch, so I'm curious if it makes sense to move this function call above `process_effective_balance_updates(state)` during `process_epoch`, i.e. before the effective balance is updated in the state, so that we use the previous epoch's effective balance when calculating the quorum threshold
Want to mention the `verify prev randao` check during execution processing, which uses the post state of the block with different randao mixes.
